annual.label: Average yearly repair and maintenance cost, Transit-250 (RepairPal)

maint.job: Synthetic blend/synthetic oil and filter change
maint.every: Every 7,500–10,000 miles or per oil-life monitor; sooner for heavy delivery or idling
maint.note: The 3.2L diesel takes much more oil and a costlier filter. E-Transit needs no oil changes.

maint.every: About every 30,000–50,000 miles (shorter in delivery use)

maint.note: Owners report rear brakes wearing faster than the fronts.

maint.every: About every 60,000 miles on the EcoBoost, about 100,000 on the non-turbo V6
maint.note: Not needed on the 3.2L diesel or the E-Transit.

maint.every: First at about 100,000 miles or 6–10 years, then per the owner's manual
maint.note: Vans built through 2018 used orange coolant; Ford recommends switching to Motorcraft Yellow when servicing. Do not mix types.
